trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation with an estimated obtuse angle between 120-140 degrees at the central junction point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged profile across the entire horizontal boundary; high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks and valleys localized along the lateral lobe margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe edges follow a convex-to-upward-concave curve transitioning from the medial section to the extreme distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, contiguous chain of high-intensity yellow-white pixel clusters (approx. 5-15 pixels in diameter each) lining the perimeter of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, white curvilinear pixel disruptions visible on the dark dorsal surface of the left lobe, extending medially.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral barnacle colonization forming a high-contrast serrated border along both the leading and trailing edges.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity white pixel noise due to water spray and splashing at the lower peduncle-water interface and along the upper edge.
